rationale: Because the Chief is in the majority and repeatedly emphasizes a narrow, stare-decisis-respecting path applying Gonzaga/Blessing and rejecting an Armstrong-based carveout, he is most likely to keep the opinion assignment and write a restrained opinion for the Court. Justice Thomas is likely to write alone to press the Pennhurst/Spending-Clause-structure objection, while one or more conservatives (especially Gorsuch/Barrett/Alito) may add a concurrence to underscore limits and avoid any broader endorsement of § 1983 enforcement of Spending Clause statutes.
